verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code CLI, but the pack documents neither versioned APIs nor a deprecation policy. The manifesto's "Backwards-compatible" line is a general principle, not a deprecation policy. Module version management concerns users' modules, not the product's own interfaces. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
